input.message:
Dear Mr Okoye,

Thank you for calling us today. I'm sorry this has left your account overdrawn. Here is where things stand.

What our records show: on 28 August you sent a Faster Payment of £4,980.00 to HARROW & VALE RE LIME PROPERTY CA with the reference "MOVE IN 14 GROVE". A Direct Debit to H&V COLLECT / LIME PROPERTY (reference LP-14GROVE-0208) was set up on 2 September. On 14 September that Direct Debit collected £4,980.00 and was paid, which took your account overdrawn. An unarranged overdraft fee of £6.50 was charged the same day. Our records show what you paid but not how Lime Property applied your 28 August payment to your account with them.

Your claim under the Direct Debit Guarantee: we have asked our Direct Debit team to deal with your claim for the £4,980.00 collected on 14 September. We have told them that you dispute the amount, that you had already paid £4,980.00 by transfer on 28 August, and that the overdraft fees are building up. We have asked them to look at the fees too. The team still has to make a decision on your claim. We can't yet confirm a refund or say when it will be decided.

Cancelling the Direct Debit: we have not cancelled it yet. To do that, please confirm in the secure portal that you want to cancel Direct Debit LP-14GROVE-0208 to Lime Property. Please don't reply in chat or by email to confirm. Once it's cancelled, there will be no further collections under that Direct Debit. Cancelling won't reverse the £4,980.00 already taken, because that is dealt with through your Guarantee claim. Your £795 monthly rent will also no longer be collected this way, so you may want to agree another way to pay it with Lime Property.

Please don't make any further payment to Lime Property for this amount while your claim is open.

Kind regards,
Harrow & Vale Bank plc
